description: This file defines the StandaloneSiloHandle class, which manages the lifecycle of a silo process in the Orleans testing framework. It includes process creation, output/error handling, and graceful shutdown logic.

classes.name: StandaloneSiloHandle
classes.description: A class that manages a silo process, including starting, stopping, and handling process output and errors.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and starts a new silo process based on configuration.

methods.name: CreateDelegate
methods.description: Returns a delegate to spawn a silo process with a specified executable path.

methods.name: CreateForAssembly
methods.description: Creates a delegate to spawn a silo process from a given assembly, handling .dll and executable files.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the process asynchronously and manages output/error streams.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo process gracefully or immediately based on parameter.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo process with a cancellation token.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources and stops the process if active.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes resources and stops the process.
